newsitem.title: RWANDA: Tanzanian president on Rwanda visit.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian president on Rwanda visit.

text.p: Tanzanian President Benjamin Mkapa arrived in Rwanda on Monday for two days of talks on the violent Great Lakes region, government officials said.
They said Mkapa was holding talks with President Pasteur Bizimungu and military strongman and Vice-President Major-General Paul Kagame.
"It is a working visit and the situation in the Great Lakes is dominating their discussions," a government official said.
Diplomats said the conflict in eastern Zaire, where rebels have driven out Zaire's ragged army and ethnic war in neighbouring Burundi, were dominating Mkapa's meeting with Rwandan leaders.
